The official binary archives also contain upstream source, scripts, and documentation.
Cheesse communicates with Stockfish as a separate process using UCI.
The official NNUE neural-network weights are embedded in these upstream binaries;
Cheesse does not train, modify, or ship a custom neural network.
To rebuild Stockfish, follow the bundled source README, src/Makefile, and scripts/net.sh;
the network filenames are pinned in src/evaluate.h and fetched by upstream's build scripts.
Upstream compilation guide: https://official-stockfish.github.io/docs/stockfish-wiki/Compiling-from-source.html
